output.name: case_growth_rate
output.definition: (cases in last 30 days - cases in the previous 30 days) / previous 30 days
output.caveat: Recent days are under-counted because of notification lag, which biases the growth rate downward. Cases are dated by symptom onset (notification date if absent).

output.name: mortality_rate
output.definition: deaths (EVOLUCAO 2 or 3) / cases with known outcome, last 12 months
output.caveat: In-hospital case fatality among notified SRAG cases, not population mortality. Cases still open or with unknown outcome are excluded, which can bias the rate.

output.name: icu_admission_rate
output.definition: cases admitted to ICU (UTI=1) / cases with known ICU field, last 12 months
output.caveat: PROXY. True ICU occupancy needs bed capacity, which this dataset does not contain. This is the share of notified SRAG hospitalisations that required ICU.

output.name: vaccination_rate
output.definition: cases that received a COVID-19 vaccine (VACINA_COV=1) / cases with known vaccination field, last 12 months
output.caveat: PROXY. True population coverage needs a population denominator, absent here. This is the vaccinated share among notified SRAG cases, not among the population.
